answer: Because the timing is written down against the inlet challenge, the orchard audit can replay the spiral history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 279 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 24 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
